nodes.name: Every hour
nodes.notes: Hourly rather than daily on purpose. With a once-a-day run, a 24h minimum actually means 24-48h, and anyone finishing the survey after the run time waits an extra day. Hourly makes it minAgeHours +/- 1h. Cost is one query an hour that almost always finds nothing; claim_rating_candidates() guarantees nobody is claimed twice however often it is called.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these six values and nothing else. webhookBase must match the Capture rating workflow's PRODUCTION webhook URL with the trailing /rate removed.

nodes.name: Claim candidates
nodes.notes: Calls claim_rating_candidates. The RPC creates each invite row as it returns it, so a crash after this point costs that person their email rather than sending it twice. Needs the SERVICE ROLE key — see README. Auth is a Header Auth credential with header name "apikey" and the Supabase SECRET key as the value — this project uses the new sb_secret_ key format, which is not a JWT, so Authorization: Bearer does not work on it.

nodes.name: Send rating email
nodes.notes: Generic SMTP, so it works with Gmail app passwords, Mailgun, Postmark, SendGrid SMTP and the rest. Swap this one node for a provider node if you would rather use an API key.
